chapter: Blue Devils, Moten and the Reno Club
title: Hammond, Benny Goodman and the supposed Kansas City visit
summary: Basie says he never saw Goodman in Kansas City, only heard that he was there, and did not give the quoted account.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: "That's where Benny Goodman and John Hammond entered the picture. On one trip to Kansas City, John caught the band at the club. He was just a youngster then but just as much of a jazz enthusiast as he is now."
"John liked the band and went about talking about us to a lot of people including B.G." Is that what you call him?

Oh, that's what it says here. "We were broadcasting over a local Kansas City station from the Reno Club and John told Benny to listen in on one of the broadcasts. Benny did and he was interested enough to make a special trip to Kansas City to hear the band in person." Yes?
Did you say any of this?
(Inaudible) some of it, but I didn't say that.
I guess maybe somebody told me Benny was there, but I never saw him. Somebody said, you know, but I
No, never seen him. That was before I left Kansas City. I never seen Benny.
